# Incident: Japanese Content Written in English-Original Rule Files

## What happened

`incidents.md` and `glossary.md` under `.claude/rules/core/` — designated as the English originals always loaded by Claude — had all their content written in Japanese. This made them functionally identical to their JP mirrors in `.claude/rules-jp/core/`, defeating the purpose of the EN/JP split.

Additionally, the JP mirror files (`rules-jp/core/incidents.md` and `rules-jp/core/glossary.md`) were using the old blockquote format (`> ⚠️ **日本語ミラー** ...`) for the warning comment, instead of the mark-generated HTML comment format.

## Root cause

No explicit rule or guideline stated that English-original rule files must contain only English. The convention was assumed but never enforced. When these files were first created, their content was written in Japanese without flagging a violation.

## Fix (PR123)

- Rewrote all content in `incidents.md` (17 entries) and `glossary.md` (31 entries) in English
- Changed column headers in `glossary.md` from `用語/説明` to `Term/Description`
- Updated JP mirror warning comments from blockquote to mark-generated HTML comment format

## Prevention

English-original rule files under `.claude/rules/` must contain only English content. JP-specific content belongs exclusively in the corresponding `.claude/rules-jp/` mirror.
